integrity: All finite enumeration and integer Morse calculations can be reproduced from the included standalone program; the homotopy upgrade uses standard mathematical theorems. This is self-review, not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for the eighteen-vertex Pappus incidence graph only. The character determines the rational homology trace for every automorphism; no integral module decomposition, general cubic-graph theorem, or equivariant sphere-wedge equivalence is claimed. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Forty \(10\)-spheres and an invariant rational line in the Pappus induced-forest complex
